mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-quarter acceleration in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 5-year moving average signals a strengthening demand environment that supports corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth decelerates below its 5-year moving average in the subsequent quarter, the signal fails to predict positive 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rebounds above its 12-month moving average within the next month, the signal fails to predict negative 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5% for the next 3 months, the signal fails to predict negative 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE remains below 4.5% for the next 3 months, the signal fails to predict negative 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average signals a strengthening housing market that supports construction sector earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST falls below its 12-month moving average in the subsequent month, the signal fails to predict positive 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals a contraction in aggregate demand that reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS rebounds above its 12-month moving average within the next month, the signal fails to predict negative 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 5% signals an inflationary environment that leads to aggressive monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL remains below 5% for the next 3 months, the signal fails to predict negative 20-day forward returns.

failure_condition: If UNRATE remains below 60% for the next 3 months, the signal fails to predict positive 20-day forward returns.
